snippet.title: Time Capsule Trailer (Free Add-On!)
snippet.description:
Download for Free: https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/oreville-studios/time-capsule-add--on/5877952a-9539-449b-881e-b2962d619363
Join Community: https://orevillestudios.com/discord

To round up the 15 Year Celebration, we worked with Minecraft to recreate the real-life Time Capsule at the Minecraft Experience Center in Redmond WA! Decorate it, store treasures, and set a timer of up to 15 years to lock them away. Stored items even get unique labels showing how long they’ve been preserved. Save your treasures for memory lane!

Learn More: https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/the-minecraft-time-capsule-sealing

Follow Oreville Studios to stay up to date! Join our community on Discord to give feedback, and receive support, or reach out to us via email.

X: https://x.com/orevillestudios
Discord: https://orevillestudios.com/discord
Support: support@orevillestudios.com

Music composed by Knyght Music (Rebecca Corfield)
https://www.knyght.uk/
